description:
Sacrifice Tenacious Dead to Ashnod's Altar, generating {2}.
Pitiless Plunderer, Blood Artist, and Tenacious Dead trigger; stack the triggers to resolve in that order.
Pitiless Plunderer generates a Treasure token; crack it to float {B}.
Blood Artist drains each opponent for 1.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from the graveyard.
Repeat the sacrifice-recursion loop draining opponent infinitely with Blood Artist triggers.
